description: This file provides Italian localization strings for the Select2 jQuery plugin version 4.0.6-rc.1, defining messages displayed during search, loading, and selection constraints.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the message shown when results cannot be be loaded.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns message prompting user to delete excess characters.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns message prompting user to input more characters.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns message indicating more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns message indicating maximum number of selections allowed.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns message when no search results are found.
